{{Top|leg}}
'''W325''' was the designation of a very small, [[Bath/Legends|bath]]-tub shaped object used to inspect and repair the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ''[[Wennis]]'', while she was in [[Realspace/Legends|deep space]]. It did not quite earn the status of an auxiliary vessel due to its size and power output and it was more of a rigid [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuit]] that was employed while the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was stationary.
